purpose: Independent TOML corpus for the differential comparison between the legacy bounded subset and the pinned smol-toml donor.

fixtures.source:
[package]
name = "strumentini-core"
version = "0.3.1"
edition = "2024"
description = """
Utility local-first, senza upload.
"""
license = "MIT"
keywords = ["utility", "local-first", "italiano"]

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
tokio = { version = "1.44", features = ["rt-multi-thread"] }

[[bin]]
name = "strumentini"
path = "src/main.rs"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
incremental = false

[project]
name = "documenti-locali"
version = "2.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
  "httpx>=0.28",
  "pydantic>=2.9",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
test = ["pytest>=8.3"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I"]
ignore = ["E501"]

title = "Configurazione ☕"
started = 1979-05-27
release = 1979-05-27T07:32:00Z
ratio = 0.75

[layer.one]
inline = { width = 640, height = 480 }
features = { alpha = true, beta = false }

[[route]]
path = "/"
methods = ["GET"]

[[route]]
path = "/api"
methods = ["POST", "PUT"]

arr = [1, 2, 3]
point = { x = 1, y = 2 }
nested = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
text = "a # b" # commento finale
